method.metric: maximum sliding 200ms stereo RMS across the entire naturally held one-shot, not LUFS or subjective loudness
method.hold: complete native one-shot duration after pitch shift
method.signal: native OfflineAudioContext, same .25*velocity=0.2 voice gain; no EQ, compressor, guard, background or master added

policy.reason: At velocity1 and existing +5dB common/+5dB manual boosts, single-voice peak remains <=~0.791 before master; polyphony still needs existing output protection.
policy.runtimeOutsideMeasuredRange: do not claim calibrated outside MIDI43..76
